parameters.query:
SELECT fcr.*, uc.name AS usecase_name
FROM "User_UC_Mappings" uum
JOIN feedback_config_rules fcr ON fcr.id = uum.feedback_config_rule_id
JOIN "UseCase" uc ON uc.usecase_id = fcr.usecase_id
WHERE uum.user_id = $1
  AND uum.active = TRUE
  AND fcr.active = TRUE
  AND LOWER(uc.name) = LOWER($2)
ORDER BY fcr.id
LIMIT 1;

parameters.content:
## Test Mapping
Read-only mapping preview based on the active Vibration Orchestrator schema. It intentionally contains no sensor logging, history lookup, cooldown check, or timestamp update.
